$description: sendwire design tokens — W3C DTCG. SOURCE OF TRUTH. Authored from brand/reference/brand/design.md (the atomic brand system, Stitch DESIGN.md format). Top-level group names map to Tailwind v4 theme namespaces (color → --color-*, spacing → --spacing-*, text → --text-*, tracking → --tracking-*, leading → --leading-*, radius → --radius-*, font → --font-*). Identity palette + functional ramps are colors; the ramp is functional-only (states/surfaces/semantics), never a brand accent — hence namespaced under color.ramp.*.

deep-purple.$description: Dominant dark canvas — default page/section background (dark-first).

primary-purple.$description: The brand colour. Primary buttons/CTAs, links, active accent. Purple 600 anchor.

primary-purple-deep.$description: Hover/active state for primary-purple surfaces. A state, not a brand colour.

mid-purple.$description: Gradients, glow, focus ring, strand highlights on dark. Decorative depth, not text on dark.

light-purple.$description: Light-mode surfaces/cards. Pair with deep-purple ink, never white text.

white.$description: Primary text/key marks on dark; negative space on light.

yellow.$description: Rare single-mark accent (app-icon asterisk, occasional strand). Never a second brand colour or a text background.

ui-green.$description: Product status only — uptime dot, progress, checkmarks, active badges. Forbidden as decoration.

surface-dark.$description: Raised cards/panels on the deep-purple canvas (one step up, same hue).

line-dark.$description: Hairline rules, borders, dividers on dark.

muted-on-dark.$description: Secondary/caption text on deep purple. Purple-tinted, clears 4.5:1 on #120C16.

ramp.$description: Functional ramps — product-UI mechanics only (states, surfaces, feedback/semantics). Purple 600/900 are the brand anchors. Per-step ratios are vs WHITE (light-mode reference); on the dark canvas the scale reads inverted — verify the real fg-on-bg pair.

red.$description: Error / destructive semantics only — the one sanctioned use of red.

yellow.$description: Warning / caution semantics only. Distinct from the identity single-mark yellow.

green.$description: Positive / success semantics + product status (the UI-green job, with a full accessible scale).

purple.$description: Brand + interactive ramp. Hover/active/focus/selected/tonal depth. 600 = primary purple, 900 = deep purple.

neutral.$description: Text, surfaces, borders, dividers. Purple-tinted by design (tinted-neutral rule — no true grays).

font.$description: One neo-grotesque family, two weights. Graphik (Commercial Type); DM Sans is the sanctioned open-source fallback. Same stack for display and body — contrast comes from weight, not pairing.

text.$description: Responsive type scale (clamp). Display 200px hero ceiling capped to ~5.5rem on web.

tracking.$description: Tight display tracking is signature. -0.04em is the floor; never tighter.

gutter.$description: Page-side gutter — the container utility's inline padding.

section.$description: Vertical rhythm between page sections (mobile) — the py-section utility.

section-lg.$description: Vertical rhythm between page sections at the lg breakpoint and up.

radius.$description: Pill (999px) is the house button shape; cards use lg (20px).
